premise: A big turtle crawls slowly up the beach; Sandpiper has never seen her, but she was born right here long ago and has come back across the whole sea.
inspiration: The Odyssey's long homecoming made tiny and gentle: the traveller comes home not to fight but to say hello to the sand where she began.
lesson: Home stays with you, however far you go.
learning: Sea turtles come back to the beach where they hatched.

en-US.title: Turtle Comes Back
en-US.text: [slowly] Slowly, slowly, {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Turtle came crawling up the sand. {sfx:shuffle} Flip… flop… flip… {sandpiper:enter by run} {sandpiper:go to turtle by run} Sandpiper came running to see. {sandpiper:face surprised} [curious] Who are you? I've never seen you before! {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live talk} [warmly] Ah, but I've been here before, said Turtle. Long, long ago, I hatched right here, a teeny-tiny turtle in the warm sand. {sandpiper:wobble} Then I crawled down to the water and swam away. All the way across the wide sea… and back again. {turtle:glow 0.4} [in awe] Turtles always come home, she said, to the beach where they were born. {sandpiper:live peck} Sandpiper pecked at the ground, as if he might find the very spot. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish waved hello from the pool, {starfish:live wave} as excited as can be. {turtle:live peek} Turtle tucked her head in, shy for a moment, then peeked out with a smile. Welcome home, said Sandpiper. {turtle:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Then Turtle turned round {turtle:go to sea by swim} and swam off, far away. {sandpiper:live wave} Until next time.

es-ES.title: Tortuga vuelve a casa
es-ES.text: [slowly] Despacito, despacito, {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Tortuga subió arrastrándose por la arena. {sfx:shuffle} Flip… flop… flip… {sandpiper:enter by run} {sandpiper:go to turtle by run} Correlimos vino corriendo a mirar. {sandpiper:face surprised} [curious] ¿Quién eres? ¡Nunca te había visto! {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live talk} [warmly] Ah, pero yo ya he estado aquí, dijo Tortuga. Hace muchísimo tiempo nací justo aquí, una tortuguita diminuta en la arena calentita. {sandpiper:wobble} Luego bajé hasta el agua y me fui nadando. Crucé todo el ancho mar… y he vuelto. {turtle:glow 0.4} [in awe] Las tortugas siempre vuelven, dijo, a la playa donde nacieron. {sandpiper:live peck} Correlimos picoteó el suelo, como si pudiera encontrar el sitio exacto. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella saludaba desde la charca, {starfish:live wave} emocionadísima. {turtle:live peek} Tortuga escondió la cabeza, un poco tímida, y luego asomó con una sonrisa. Bienvenida a casa, dijo Correlimos. {turtle:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Después, Tortuga se dio la vuelta {turtle:go to sea by swim} y se alejó nadando, muy lejos. {sandpiper:live wave} Hasta la próxima.
